in_marathi.name: Kamendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Will, Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kama’ (desire) and ‘Indra’ (god), Kamendra means 'God's Will' or 'Desire of God'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings of power, wisdom, and prosperity.
